Code graph of a tree (tree-sitter Rust, oxc TS/JS, Markdown): calls, imports, communities, god nodes; runs fw-graph

## Usage

```bash
fw graph <build <dir> [--json f] [--report f]|query <question>|explain <node>|path <a> <b>|report|export>
```

## Aliases

`fw graphify` runs `fw graph`.

## Subcommands

```bash
fw graph build
fw graph query
fw graph explain
fw graph path
fw graph report
fw graph export
```

The names come from the usage line.

## Flags

The help text names these flags: `--json`, `--report`.
